# Default thresholds

These are starting points for small and mid-sized businesses. Replace them with the owner's own targets whenever they exist, and say in the review when defaults were used. Amounts are in the company's own currency.

## Cash

| Status | Runway |
| --- | --- |
| Green | 6 months or more |
| Amber | 3 to 6 months |
| Red | Under 3 months |

Runway = cash now / average monthly net burn. If the business is cash-flow positive, show that instead.

## Revenue trend versus prior period

| Status | Change |
| --- | --- |
| Green | 0% or better |
| Amber | 0% to -5% (monthly) or 0% to -10% (weekly) |
| Red | Worse than -5% (monthly) or -10% (weekly) |

## Receivables

| Status | Rule |
| --- | --- |
| Green | Nothing more than 30 days past due |
| Amber | Any invoice 31 to 60 days past due |
| Red | Any invoice 61 or more days past due, or more than 10% of receivables in that bucket |

Name every invoice more than 30 days past due.

## Pipeline coverage

| Status | Weighted pipeline / revenue target |
| --- | --- |
| Green | 2 times or more |
| Amber | 1 to 2 times |
| Red | Under 1 time |

Flag deals with no activity for 14 days, and open deals whose close date has passed.
